types.title: Pack
types.description: One pack: a folder with a pack.json, or a pack kept as an item. What it declares is part_of it; what it needs and offers are names.

pack_id.description: Its id, as pack.json says it (core, loader, design).

kind.description: kernel is core; root a kernel module in roots.json; island words only; map habits for the whole map; server reaches the server.

home.description: Where it is kept: packs/ of the open core, the hosted repository, or an item on a map.

version.description: Its version, as pack.json says it.

trust.description: Its kernel trust (service), when it has kernel code.

root_order.description: Its place in roots.json, for a root pack: a root imports only the roots before it.

blob.description: The git blob hash of its pack.json as last synced.

types.title: Bundle
types.description: Packs that go on and off together, often an island pack of words and the map pack that acts on them. A pack is part_of its bundle.

bundle_id.description: Its id, as bundle.json says it.

types.title: Item type
types.description: A type a pack declares, part_of that pack. It extends another (extends), and what it grants (has:<capability>) are names.

statuses.description: Its statuses, open | closed (todo doing | done dropped).

adds_fields.description: An entry with of: it adds fields to another pack's type rather than declaring one.

types.title: Link type
types.description: A link type a pack declares, part_of that pack. Its ends are joins links to item types or names; a root link type extends nothing.

root.description: A root link: core's own, extended by others.

types.title: Part
types.description: Anything else a pack declares, part_of that pack: a rule, view, action, handler, layout, style, instruction, lens, or a server pack's reach.

part.description: Which key of the manifest it is; hook is one of its kernel hooks (surface.views).

side.description: Words an island pack may hold (types, links, rules, kernel-drawn views, instructions, lenses), or habits only a map pack may.

types.title: Name
types.description: What a pack asks for or offers, never a pack: has:<capability>, type:<id>, event:<kind>, field:<f>@<type>, status:, phase: or service:<family>.<entry>. Whichever active pack declares or provides it provides it.

form.description: Its form; service is a service a pack provides in its kernel key (service:answer.flat, service:root.dump), pack the old form, a bare pack id.

takes.description: For a service: the shape it takes, as its provider declares it (JSON).

gives.description: For a service: the shape it answers with (JSON).

types.title: Module
types.description: A file of code: a pack's module, a page module of ui/, a file of src/ or a script. Part of the pack that owns it; none yet for the page and src. Its note is its header comment.

path.description: Its path from the repository's root.

layer.description: Where it sits: a root pack's kernel, another pack's code, src/, the page (ui/), or a script.

blob.description: The git blob hash of the file as last synced: a sync redoes it only when this moves.

moves_to.description: The pack it is meant to move into, while its path puts it in none (a page module, src/): a plan a person or agent sets. The sync never sets it; once the file moves, its path says its pack.

types.title: Version
types.description: A version of a pack tried on one island (a pack item with version_of), or a released version of one. version_of its pack, pinned_on the islands that run it.

carries_code.description: It carries code of its own (a version of a server's pack).

types.title: Principle
types.description: A rule the architecture keeps (one name, one owner; users leave before the provider). It governs what it is about and is kept_in the modules that enforce it.

axis.description: What it is about: what a pack holds, where it applies (islands), or when (the log, order).

decision.description: The decision on the map that made it (e_...).

check.description: The structure test's check that holds it, by its name.

breaks.description: How many known breaks that check still lists: 0 when the principle holds.

types.title: Test
types.description: A test file. It tests the modules it reads, as test/sets.ts says.

path.description: Its path from the repository's root.

slow.description: In the slow set: left out of the local fast run, run in CI.

blob.description: The git blob hash of the file as last synced.

types.title: Store
types.description: Where a pack keeps state: a table it declares, an operational stream, or its memory. Part of its pack.

types.title: Sync
types.description: Where the island stands against the code: the commits it was last synced to. One per island.

commits.description: Each repository and the commit synced, as repo@sha, one per line.

full.description: The last sync was a full run, every file read.

links.title: requires
links.description: The pack cannot work without this name: while nothing active provides it, the pack waits, saying which.

links.title: uses
links.description: The pack works with this name while it is provided, and without it otherwise.

links.title: provides
links.description: The pack declares what this name asks for, so it provides it. Read off its declarations, never claimed.

links.title: calls
links.description: The pack calls a service (service:root.dump), as its kernel calls or roots.json list it.

links.title: grants
links.description: The type declares this capability (has:when), so any pack requiring it may build on it.

links.title: extends
links.description: The type or link type builds on this one: a starter type, or a root link.

links.title: joins
links.description: An end of the link type: a type or a capability. Say which end in props.end (from or to); * is left unsaid.

links.title: reads
links.description: What a part reads of a type it does not own (field:, status:, phase:), checked by shape against its provider.

links.title: hears
links.description: A handler is run on this event (event:item.due).

links.title: records
links.description: A handler's answers may log this kind of event (event:...): any other is refused.

links.title: moved from
links.description: The pack took declarations from this one, keeping their ids, so a map that had it changes nothing.

links.title: is a version of
links.description: The version stands in for this pack where it is pinned.

links.title: is pinned on
links.description: The island that runs this version in place of the map's (its pack_version).

links.title: is kept in
links.description: The code that holds or enforces it, or runs a service.

links.title: governs
links.description: What the principle decides about: modules, packs, a kind of part, a name, another principle.

links.title: imports
links.description: The module imports the other. props.type_only when it imports types alone, which no rule of import order counts.

links.title: tests
links.description: The test reads it: imports it at any depth, or names its path.

styles.title: How packs lean on each other
Model a pack with the anatomy pack
styles.body: On the pack anatomy island, a pack is an anatomy.pack, and everything it declares is part_of it: an anatomy.type, an anatomy.link_type, or an anatomy.part for a rule, view, action, handler, layout, style or reach. What it asks for or offers is an anatomy.name (has:, type:, event:, field:, status:), linked requires, uses or provides: never a link from pack to pack, except moved_from. A rule the architecture keeps is an anatomy.principle that governs what it is about and is kept_in the modules that enforce it. Read pack.json before you write, and keep ids as it says them. Code is modelled from files: each anatomy.module part_of its pack and linked imports to what it imports, each anatomy.test linked tests to what it reads; a sync item says which commits the island stands at.
